verdict.rationale: Parsec documents near-zero latency, up to 240 FPS (60 FPS at 4K), 4:4:4 color, and Wacom pressure/tilt for interactive use. Hands-on community reports corroborate smooth, close-to-60fps interactive use, including gaming over 4G. The hardware-encoding half of the story is never stated by the vendor; it is only implied by a community remark about wanting NVENC-based desktop streaming. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of hardware (GPU) encoding, measured latency figures.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing

citations.quote: a seamless 4k experience at up to 60 frames per second with near-zero latency
